chunks: As for what was narrated by Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurārah, who said:

Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: Jumuʿah is obligatory upon one who, if he performs the morning prayer among his family, can still reach the Friday prayer. And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would only perform the ʿaṣr prayer at the time of ẓuhr on the rest of the days, so that when they had completed the prayer with the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, they would return to their dwellings before nightfall. And that is a sunnah until the Day of qiyamah.

So the proper way regarding this report is that we carry it upon a form of recommendation rather than obligation and requirement, because the obligation pertains to one who is at the distance of two farsakhs.

key_terms.فَرْسَخَيْنِ: a distance measure of two farsakhs

ai.seo_question: Upon whom is Jumuʿah prayer obligatory according to this hadith from al-Istibṣār?
ai.summary: This report discusses the legal scope of the obligation of Jumuʿah prayer and links it to travel distance and practical accessibility. It also cites the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding prayer timing, while clarifying that this particular report is understood as indicating recommendation rather than strict obligation beyond the established limit.
